engine:
Extract LoG2 enemy AI (state table 0x086d5194, 152 states) -> data/log2/ai.json.

Engine (VERIFIED by disassembly of 0x0801a9cc..0x0801ab64, 0x0800e5a4):
  * Every enemy owns an AI controller at entity+0x19c: +0 owner, +4 stack depth (max 5), +8.. stack of
    (runtime node object*, state-table entry*) pairs, +0x30 pending-destroy count, +0x34.. pending list.
  * State table 0x086d5194: 152 x [behaviour_root_node*, on_hit_root_node*].
    push(state)=0x0801aa98, replace-top(state)=0x0801aa46, pop=0x0801aad4, tick=0x0801ab08 (called from enemy
    update 0x0800e5a4 every frame), on-hit dispatch=0x0801ab2a (called from enemy onMessage 0x0800e5b8 after damage
    is computed: calls top-state on_hit_root.fn1(node, entity, hit)).
  * The initial state is the class row's ai_state (class table +8): pushed by enemy init 0x0800e280.
  * Nodes are ROM structs: word0 = create(node, entity) -> runtime object (vtable: [enter, update->done?, exit,
    destroy]), word1 = onHit(node, entity, hit) -> handled?, word2 = reset/exit helper, then type-specific params.
    Nodes whose word0 is 0 are on-hit-only nodes (identified by word1).
Distances are measured centre-to-centre in pixels on the collision boxes (box from 0x0800793a: x>>8,y>>8,w=+0x154,h=+0x155);
radius params are stored squared. Speeds are in 1/256 px per frame. Probabilities are per-frame, out of 65536 (rand16 < p).
Facing byte entity+0x10: 0=down,1=up,2=left,3=right.

node_types.name: Sequence
node_types.semantics: Runs children in order; enter=child0.enter; when a child update returns done, exit it and enter the next; done after last. onHit: first child whose onHit returns true (0x0801b689). Runtime vtable 0x080247ec (0x0801b5ab/0x0801b5c1/0x0801b623).

node_types.name: RaceFirst
node_types.semantics: Enters all children; each frame updates children in order and returns done as soon as one returns done (short-circuit, later children not ticked that frame). vtable 0x08024548 (update 0x0801b80b).

node_types.name: RaceAll
node_types.semantics: Like RaceFirst but ticks every child each frame (OR of results). vtable 0x08024d98 (update 0x0801b7db).

node_types.name: IfPlayerWithin
node_types.semantics: Each frame: if player exists and dist^2(player centre, self centre) <= r2 run child A (near) else child B (far); switching exits the old child and enters the new one. Result = running child result. onHit routed the same way (0x0801af2b). vtable 0x0802413c.

node_types.name: IfPlayerSeen
node_types.semantics: Child A (seen) when player within r and NOT directly behind the enemy (behind = facing points away from player along the dominant axis, test 0x0801d5d0); else child B. vtable 0x08025014.

node_types.name: Chance
node_types.semantics: Each frame with probability p/65536 (rand16<p, 0x0802142e) ticks the child and returns its result, otherwise returns not-done. onHit likewise gated (0x0801ba69). vtable 0x08023d58.

node_types.name: WhileInMeleeRange
node_types.semantics: Ticks child only while the player hurtbox overlaps the enemy melee box (own hurtbox +3px right, -4px left, -6px bottom; 0x0801beb8). vtable 0x0802410c.

node_types.name: WhileInMeleeRangeB
node_types.semantics: Same with a slightly different box (0x0801e8b4: +2 left/top, -3 right, -6 bottom).

node_types.name: GotoState
node_types.semantics: When updated (or on hit, via onHit 0x0801ab7b) replaces the top of the AI stack with state st (0x0801aa46).

node_types.name: PushState
node_types.semantics: Pushes state st on the AI stack (0x0801aa98) when updated / on hit (0x0801a733).

node_types.name: SubState
node_types.semantics: Inlines state st: create = st.behaviour.create, onHit = st.on_hit.onHit.

node_types.name: Wait
node_types.semantics: Counts down f frames then done (runtime 0x08023bf0, update 0x0801bb95).

node_types.name: WaitPose
node_types.semantics: Wait f frames while showing a pose/flash anim object (0x0802455c).

node_types.name: ChasePlayer
node_types.semantics: Moves straight toward the player: velocity = (dx,dy)*spd/max(|dx|,|dy|) (so spd px/frame along the dominant axis), wall-sliding (tries full, x-only, y-only via 0x0800e45e); faces dominant axis; never completes.

node_types.name: FleePlayer
node_types.semantics: Same as ChasePlayer but away from the player; done when blocked by walls.

node_types.name: AlignWithPlayer
node_types.semantics: Moves along the minor axis until within 3px of the player row/column, then faces the player along the major axis and completes (used before firing straight projectiles).

node_types.name: BackAway
node_types.semantics: Faces the player while moving away at spd; never completes.

node_types.name: BackAwayUntilBlocked
node_types.semantics: Faces player, moves away; completes when movement is blocked.

node_types.name: Knockback
node_types.semantics: Hit reaction: direction = hit direction (entity+0x18d from hit byte 0); speed k=(rand(64)+96)*p>>7; velocity along hit dir = 8*k /256 px/f, perpendicular jitter (rand(32768)-16384)*k>>12; plays hurt anim (state 2) and slides until the anim ends. Enemy stays hittable.

node_types.name: KnockbackInvulnerable
node_types.semantics: As Knockback but clears entity+0x168 (hittable flag) for the duration and sets it back on exit (0x0801acad): invincibility frames = hurt animation length.

node_types.name: MeleeStrike
node_types.semantics: On enter: if the player is alive, builds a melee hitbox from the enemy box extended 3-4px toward the player, faces the player, broadcasts a hit (attack table id 2 = melee power 1024, scale 1024; damage uses enemy STR) to the player, plays random hit sfx (rand(3)+0x22), then plays attack anim 6+rand(p). Update waits for the anim to end.

node_types.name: ContactDamage
node_types.semantics: Touch damage: every frame, if >48 frames since last hit and the player overlaps the enemy attack box, hit the player with attack id 2 (melee 1024).

node_types.name: Charge
node_types.semantics: Dash at spd/256 px/f along the initial direction to the player; on contact hits with attack id 2; ends after passing the player by more than p px (or blocked).

node_types.name: Pounce
node_types.semantics: Leap toward player at spd (sfx 0x81), contact hit with attack id 2, ends after max distance p.

node_types.name: LaserBeam
node_types.semantics: Faces player, plays a 60-frame anim (0x080249a8) and creates a laser object (ctor 0x0801e224, vtable 0x08024e5c): from the muzzle (offset table 0x08703294+0xc by facing) the beam grows 8 px/frame up to param px, the hit area is the segment origin->tip widened +-4 px, it hits at most once, attack id 3 (energy 1024, scale 1024, team 0); after 60 frames it retracts 8 px/frame. Ladybug robots, param 64.
node_types.evidence: VERIFIED(disasm+emu: hit 2-5 f after start, object lifetime 68 f)

node_types.name: DeathExplode
node_types.semantics: Death node (class +0x14): fn2 0x0801a74d awards exp (0x0800e4d2), queues on-death event (0x0800e39c -> spawn on-death script), explosion effect (0x0800fa1c, size 0x28) and random death sfx (rand(2)+0x1f).

node_types.name: Nop
node_types.semantics: Does nothing forever (static runtime 0x0300220c). As a death node (0x086ff3c4) its fn2 0x0801a82d awards exp and queues the on-death event without explosion.

node_types.name: Patrol
node_types.semantics: Follows the spawn waypoints (entity+0x190, 0x0800d156): cycles through the waypoint list; walk-to waypoints move at param/256 px/f.

node_types.name: PopState
node_types.semantics: Pops the AI stack when updated / on hit (0x0801aad4).

node_types.name: ClassDefaultState
node_types.semantics: Delegates to the class row ai_state: create = states[class.ai_state].behaviour.create; onHit = states[class.ai_state].on_hit.onHit (0x0801c46b).

node_types.name: ShootEnergyBall
node_types.semantics: Faces player; plays anim object 0x03002218 (vtable 0x080251b4): 32 frames, at frame 8 (if pool room) spawns projectile 0x080160c0 (vtable 0x08024258; attack id 1 energy 1024). Done when the anim ends.

node_types.name: ShootKiBlast
node_types.semantics: Faces player; anim object 0x03002224 (vtable 0x08025a70): 32 frames, at frame 16 spawns projectile via 0x0800ead8/0x0800e8b0 (attack id 3 energy 1024). Done when anim ends.

node_types.name: Succeed
node_types.semantics: Static node: update returns done immediately; onHit returns handled=true (stops on-hit processing).

node_types.name: HitFlash
node_types.semantics: Attaches hit-flash anim object (vtable 0x08024a3c) to the entity (also usable as on-hit node).

node_types.name: StunAnim
node_types.semantics: Sets the stunned/dizzy anim controller 0x03002230.

node_types.name: ClearAnim
node_types.semantics: Removes the overlay anim (0x080076bc).

node_types.name: SetIdleAnim
node_types.semantics: Sets body anim state 0 (idle) via vtable slot 0x28.

node_types.name: FacePlayer
node_types.semantics: Turns to face the player (0x0800df98) and completes; on-hit: turn to face the attacker.

node_types.name: GlowFlash
node_types.semantics: On-hit/visual: attaches a 12-frame palette-cycle anim object (vtable 0x08024a14, table 0x086fdfbc).

node_types.name: SelfDestructBurst
node_types.semantics: Eggbot death node: spawns an explosion effect (0x080135e0, gfx 0x086e1590) and broadcasts one hit with rect = own centre +-16 px (32x32), team 2 (hurts player AND enemies), attack id 3 (energy 1024, scale 1024); sfx.

node_types.name: PlaySound
node_types.semantics: Plays sound effect id p.

node_types.name: LobProjectile
node_types.semantics: Faces player and lobs an arcing projectile (0x0801ccc8: gravity 0x20/frame) that hits with attack id 1 (energy 1024) on landing.

node_types.name: ThrowProjectile
node_types.semantics: Faces player; anim object 0x03002270 (vtable 0x080256d8): at frame 8 spawns thrown-star projectile 0x0801a0b0 (vtable 0x08024f0c; attack id 1 energy 1024, 1.75 px/f, 8x8). Used by Ninjas.

node_types.name: FlyerAnimA
node_types.semantics: Flyer (hawk/pterodactyl/ladybug) anim helper (static runtime 0x03002258).

node_types.name: FlyerAnimB
node_types.semantics: Flyer anim helper (static runtime 0x0300225c, enter 0x0801c835 sets walk/fly anim).

node_types.name: DrainGrab
node_types.semantics: Cell drain grab (data 0x08701e1c). Enter: if a player exists, the player gets anim object 0x0300227c (vtable 0x080251e0: held 240 frames; each new A press subtracts 16 extra frames) and Cell gets 0x03002280 (vtable 0x08024bb4): at frame 8 one hit (attack id 2 melee, scale 256 = 1/4), then every 16 frames a hit with scale 128 (1/8); hits are applied directly (0x0800f910 + player vtable+0x40) and Cell heals by the damage dealt (vtable+0x3c). No range check in the node. Ends when the player is released (+8-frame wind-down). Used in states 89 (Cell) and 127 (Cell Nonperfect).
node_types.evidence: VERIFIED(disasm+emu: hold 240 f, 8 then 4 dmg every 16 f; first hit crit 17)

node_types.name: SprayAttack
node_types.semantics: Destroyer energy spray (data 0x08701e4c): faces player, 128-frame anim 0x03002288 (vtable 0x080254c4, sfx 0xBD); from frame 4 one particle per frame (ctor 0x0801dcfc, vtable 0x080250a8, pool permitting) at the mouth offset (table 0x08701e28+4 by facing), velocity 2 px/f along facing +-0.375 px/f random jitter on both axes, life 20 frames, 16x16 hit box; each particle hits the player once with attack id 3 at scale 51 (~1/20) applied directly (no hitstun, no i-frames).
node_types.evidence: VERIFIED(disasm+emu: 2-4 dmg every 1-2 frames, no player hit anim)

node_types.name: BeamAttackTao
node_types.semantics: General Tao beam (data 0x08703914): 90-frame anim; spawns the player beam class (ctor 0x080143a8, vtable 0x08024acc; offset table 0x087038d0) with scale 0x3000 (12x), attack id 10 (energy power 0x40) per frame; the player is hit once per invulnerability window.
node_types.evidence: VERIFIED(disasm+emu: hits every 32 f, 48-60 dmg on END 53)

node_types.name: BeamAttack
node_types.semantics: Cell beam (data 0x08704788 Nonperfect / 0x087047d4 Perfect): same as BeamAttackTao (player beam class 0x080143a8, scale 0x3000, attack id 10 power 0x40, 90-frame anim).
node_types.evidence: VERIFIED(disasm+emu: Cell NP hits every 32 f, 24-36 dmg = formula S=POW 41, power 64, scale 12288)

node_types.name: ApplyDamage
node_types.semantics: On hit: if hit.scale!=0, store hit direction in entity+0x18d and call entity vtable+0x38 (enemy takeHit 0x0800e485: HP -= hit.damage; death node when HP<=0).

node_types.name: IfAttackId
node_types.semantics: On hit: forward to child if attack.id_byte==param OR attack.type_byte==param (attack desc = hit+8).

node_types.name: IfKnockbackBlocked
node_types.semantics: On hit: probes the collision map at the knockback destination (offset table 0x086ff40c by hit direction, 0x08006366). Destination blocked by a wall -> child A (in generic handlers: KnockbackInvulnerable = i-frames, prevents wall juggling); destination free -> child B (plain Knockback, enemy stays hittable).
node_types.evidence: VERIFIED(disasm+emu: open ground -> state 2, hittable flag stays 1, 16px slide over 32 frames)

node_types.name: HealFractionOfDamage
node_types.semantics: On hit: entity vtable+0x3c heal(param * hit.raw_damage >> 16) (enemy heal 0x0800e561 clamps at max HP).
